blocks.text: Insan mein khoon ke circulatory system ke ilawa ek aur system bhi cheezon ko jism mein le jane ka kaam karta hai. Yeh tissues se cheezein wapas khoon mein bhi lata hai. Is system ko lymphatic system kehte hain. Yeh lymph vessels (lymph ki naliyan), lymphoid masses (lymphoid tissue ke dher), lymph nodes (gilttiyan) aur lymph se bana hai; lymph woh mayah hai jo is system mein behta hai.

blocks.title: Yaad karein (Recalling)
blocks.text: Villi (chhoti aant ki ungli numa ubhar) mein lymph capillaries ki shakhon ko lacteals kehte hain. Fatty acids aur glycerol villi ke epithelial cells mein jazb ho kar triglycerides banate hain. Triglycerides par proteins ki parat chadh kar chylomicrons bante hain, jo villi ke lacteals mein chale jate hain.

Lymphatic system chhoti naliyon se shuru hota hai jinhen lymph capillaries kehte hain. In ka ek sira band (blind) hota hai aur yeh extracellular fluid (cells ke bahar ka mayah, yani interstitial fluid) mein hoti hain. Interstitial fluid ka dabao use lymph capillaries mein dhakel deta hai. Lymph capillaries blood capillaries se zyada permeable hoti hain (in mein se cheezein aasani se guzarti hain), is liye bare molecules bhi in mein dakhil ho sakte hain. Jab interstitial fluid lymph capillaries mein aa jata hai to use lymph kehte hain. Lymph capillaries mil kar bari lymphatic vessels (lymphatics ya lymph vessels) banati hain. Lymph vessels mil kar aur bari lymph ducts banati hain. Do bari lymph ducts hain: right lymphatic duct aur thoracic duct. Yeh tarteeb se daen aur baen subclavian veins mein khulti hain (subclavian veins bazuon aur kandhon se khoon dil tak le jati hain). Lymph hamesha jism ke tissues se thoracic duct ki taraf behti hai. Yeh bahao skeletal muscles ke kaam, andar ke aza (viscera) ki harkat aur saans lene ki harkat se qaim rehta hai. Lymph vessels mein valves hote hain jo lymph ko wapas behne nahin dete.

blocks.alt: Gol tissue cells ke darmiyan baen taraf surkh arteriole aur daen taraf neeli venule blood capillaries ke jaal se jure hain. Hari, band siron wali lymph capillaries blood capillaries ke beech se guzarti hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Blood capillaries se rasne wala mayah (interstitial fluid) jab lymph capillaries mein dakhil ho jaye to lymph kehlata hai. Lymph capillaries ka ek sira band (blind) hota hai.

blocks.title: Sooji hui gilttiyan
blocks.text: Kuch bimariyon (maslan mumps, kan pere) mein lymph nodes ki dard wali soojan zyada tar murda lymphocytes aur macrophages ke jama hone ki wajah se hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Insani jism jis ke sar, baazuon, dhar aur tangon mein lymphatic vessels chalti hain aur gardan, baghal (armpits) aur ran (groin) mein lymph nodes ke guchhe hain. Right lymphatic duct right subclavian vein mein aur thoracic duct aorta ke saath oopar ja kar left subclavian vein mein khulti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Lymph aakhir kaar khoon mein wapas jati hai: jism ke daen oopri hisse ki lymph right lymphatic duct se, baqi sab thoracic duct se.

Lymphatic system zaid (izafi) mayah, ghule hue proteins aur doosri cheezein wapas khoon mein lata hai. Ek aam insan mein roz taqreeban teen litre mayah blood capillaries se zyada nikalta hai (jitna wapas jata hai us se zyada). Yeh mayah lymphatic capillaries jazb kar leti hain aur dil tak pohanchne se pehle khoon mein wapas daal deti hain. Lymphatic system jism ko bahar se aane wale dushmanon (germs) se bachane mein bhi madad karta hai. Lymph nodes lymph ko chhaante (filter karte) hain. In mein lymphocytes aur macrophages hote hain jo lymph mein maujood bacteria aur viruses ko khatam karte hain. Tilli (spleen) apne macrophages aur lymphocytes se khoon ko chhaanti hai; yeh bahar ke zarrat aur purane RBCs ko khatam karte hain. Tilli RBCs ko zakhira (store) bhi karti hai.

Kuch jagahon par lymph vessels mein connective tissue ke dher hote hain jin mein lymphocytes maujood hote hain. Inhen lymph nodes kehte hain. Kai afferent (andar lane wali) lymph vessels ek lymph node mein dakhil hoti hain, aur lymph sirf ek efferent (bahar le jane wali) lymph vessel se bahar nikalti hai. Insan mein lymph nodes gardan, baghal (axilla) aur raan ke jor (groin) mein hote hain. Lymph nodes ke ilawa kai lymphoid masses mukhtalif jagahon par hote hain, maslan alimentary canal ki mucosa aur submucosa (andar ki parat aur us ke neeche ki tah) mein. Bare lymphoid masses tilli (spleen), thymus, tonsils aur adenoids hain. Yeh lymphocytes banate hain.

blocks.alt: Gol lymph node jis ka hara capsule lymphocytes aur macrophages ke khanon ko gherta hai. Kinare par kai lymph vessels (lymphatics) lymph andar late hain; oopar ek lymph vessel lymph ko bahar le jati hai, aur saath khoon ki naliyon ka jora hai jahan se khoon aata aur jata hai.

blocks.text: Kai afferent vessels lymph andar late hain magar ek hi efferent vessel bahar le jati hai, is liye lymph aahista guzarti hai aur macrophages jaraseem ko khatam kar lete hain.

blocks.explanation: Blood capillaries interstitial fluid tissues mein risati rehti hain, aur zaid aam taur par lymph capillaries mein jata aur skeletal muscles ke sukar, viscera ki harkat aur saans se valve wali lymph vessels mein oopar dhakela jata hai. Khara rehna taangon ka muscle pump hata deta hai, to takhnon se lymph ka bahao sust ho jata hai, zaid mayah subclavian veins ko kafi jaldi nahin lautta, aur tissues mein soojan ke taur par jama ho jata hai.

items: Lymphatic system = lymph vessels, lymphoid masses, lymph nodes aur lymph; tissues se izafi mayah aur proteins wapas khoon mein lata hai aur jism ki hifazat karta hai.

Interstitial fluid band sire wali, zyada permeable lymph capillaries mein ja kar lymph banta hai → lymph vessels → right lymphatic duct aur thoracic duct → daen aur baen subclavian veins. Bahao muscles, viscera aur saans se chalta hai; valves wapsi rokte hain.
Roz taqreeban 3 litre izafi mayah lymph ke zariye khoon mein wapas aata hai. Villi ke lacteals chylomicrons lete hain.

Lymph nodes (gardan, baghal, groin; kai afferent aur ek efferent vessel) lymph chhaante hain; tilli khoon chhaanti, purane RBCs khatam aur RBCs zakhira karti hai. Tilli, thymus, tonsils aur adenoids lymphocytes banate hain.
